mentions.name: Sixth Coast
mentions.description: A feed aggregator backed by a web crawler that automatically discovers interesting RSS feeds across the web. Posts are sorted by inverse posting frequency, using the time between posts as a proxy for quality, surfacing interesting sites a reader wouldn't otherwise find.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's feed aggregator backed by a web crawler that tries to find interesting RSS feeds. Posts are sorted by inverse frequency with the hope that time between posts will serve as a good proxy for quality.

evidence.value: It's feed aggregator backed by a web crawler that tries to find interesting RSS feeds. Posts are sorted by inverse frequency with the hope that time between posts will serve as a good proxy for quality.
